#
# This script generates an AI Investigation Summary report from a single case record.
#
# Input Structure:
# - case: Case record containing:
#   - Case fields (tracking-id, signal-name, etc.)
#   - knowledge_base_articles: Array of KB article objects (optional context-summary, guidance, etc.)
#   - threat_intel_records: Array of threat intel objects
#   - timeline: Array of timeline event objects with event_type
#

# - alert_event: Raw alert events from security tools
# - enrichment: Automated TI enrichment results
# - vendor_response: Automated response by security vendor tools (EDR, firewall, etc.)
# - swimlane_action: Swimlane playbook remediation/response actions
# - investigation: Manual investigation notes/findings
# - escalation: Signal → Case escalations
# - status_change: Status updates
# - assignment: Claim/assignment changes

import json

from datetime import UTC
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from collections import defaultdict
from html import escape


def report_term(text: str) -> str:
    """Replace product wording Signal→Case in report-visible text (whole words, preserve case)."""
    if not text:
        return text
    s = str(text)
    s = re.sub(r"\bSIGNAL\b", "CASE", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\bSignal\b", "Case", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\bsignal\b", "case", s)
    return s


# Default Swimlane logo (base64 encoded PNG) - replace with actual logo
SWIMLANE_LOGO = ""


def parse_timestamp(timestamp_str: str) -> Optional[datetime]:
    """Parse a timestamp string into a datetime object."""
    if not timestamp_str:
        return None
    
    formats = [
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
    ]
    
    clean_timestamp = timestamp_str
    if len(timestamp_str) > 6 and timestamp_str[-6] in ['+', '-'] and timestamp_str[-3] == ':':
        clean_timestamp = timestamp_str[:-3] + timestamp_str[-2:]
    
    for fmt in formats:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(clean_timestamp, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    
    try:
        if '+' in timestamp_str:
            clean_timestamp = timestamp_str.split('+')[0]
        elif timestamp_str.count('-') > 2:
            parts = timestamp_str.rsplit('-', 1)
            if len(parts[1]) <= 5:
                clean_timestamp = parts[0]
        
        for fmt in formats[:6]:
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(clean_timestamp, fmt)
            except ValueError:
                continue
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    return None


def format_datetime(dt: Optional[datetime], include_timezone: bool = True) -> str:
    """Format a datetime object for display."""
    if not dt:
        return "N/A"
    fmt = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
    if include_timezone:
        fmt += " UTC"
    return dt.strftime(fmt)


def parse_json_field(field_value: Any) -> Any:
    """Parse a field that may be a JSON string or already parsed."""
    if isinstance(field_value, str):
        try:
            return json.loads(field_value)
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
            return field_value
    return field_value


def parse_timeline_entry(entry: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse a timeline entry that may be a JSON string or dict."""
    if isinstance(entry, str):
        try:
            return json.loads(entry)
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
            return {"title": entry, "timestamp": ""}
    return entry if isinstance(entry, dict) else {"title": str(entry), "timestamp": ""}


def is_phishing_case(case: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """Check if a case is a phishing email case."""
    phishing_fields = [
        "phishing-email-subject",
        "phishing-email-from",
        "phishing-email-message-id"
    ]
    return any(case.get(field) for field in phishing_fields)


def generate_headline(case: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Generate a headline for the report from AI analysis or case name."""
    ai_analysis = case.get("ai-verdict-analysis", "")
    if ai_analysis:
        parsed = parse_json_field(ai_analysis)
        if isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("summary"):
            return report_term(parsed["summary"])
    
    if case.get("signal-name"):
        return report_term(case["signal-name"])
    
    return "Security Case Investigation Summary"


def generate_investigation_summary(case: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Generate investigation summary from AI analysis."""
    ai_analysis = case.get("ai-verdict-analysis", "")
    if ai_analysis:

    return "No investigation summary available."

    if sender_domain and sender_domain not in str(sender_from):

    if sender_ip:

            if len(to_addresses) > 5:

        auth_results.append(f"DMARC: {status}")
    if spf:
        spf_str = str(spf).lower()
        status = "Pass" if "pass" in spf_str else "Fail" if "fail" in spf_str else report_term(str(spf))
        auth_results.append(f"SPF: {status}")
    if dkim:
        dkim_str = str(dkim).lower()
        status = "Pass" if "pass" in dkim_str else "Fail" if "fail" in dkim_str else report_term(str(dkim))
        auth_results.append(f"DKIM: {status}")

def render_timeline_section(case: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Render the Incident Timeline section."""
    timeline = case.get("timeline", [])
    
    if not timeline:
        return '<p class="empty-section">No timeline events recorded.</p>'
    
    events = [parse_timeline_entry(entry) for entry in timeline]
    
    def get_sort_key(event):
        ts = parse_timestamp(event.get("timestamp", ""))
        return ts if ts else datetime.min
    
    sorted_events = sorted(events, key=get_sort_key)
    
    html_parts = []
    
    for event in sorted_events:
        event_type = event.get("event_type", "general")
        timestamp = event.get("timestamp", "")
        parsed_time = parse_timestamp(timestamp)
        formatted_time = format_datetime(parsed_time, include_timezone=False) if parsed_time else ""
        
        title = escape(report_term(event.get("title", "Event")))
        details = event.get("details", "")
        
        time_prefix = f'<strong>{formatted_time}:</strong> ' if formatted_time else ''
        
        event_html = f'''
        <div class="timeline-event timeline-event-{escape(event_type)}">
            <p>{time_prefix}<strong>{title}</strong></p>
            {f'<p class="event-details">{escape(report_term(str(details)))}</p>' if details else ''}
        </div>
        '''
        html_parts.append(event_html)
    
    return '\n'.join(html_parts)

def render_references(case: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Render the References section with threat intelligence information."""
    ti_records = case.get("threat_intel_records", [])
    
    if not ti_records:
        return '<p class="empty-section">No threat intelligence data available.</p>'
    
    html_parts = []
    
    for ti_record in ti_records:
        observable = ti_record.get("observable", "Unknown")
        observable_type = ti_record.get("observable-type", "unknown")
        verdict = ti_record.get("threat-intelligence-verdict", "Unknown")
        risk_score = ti_record.get("turbine-risk-score", "N/A")
        tracking_id = ti_record.get("tracking-id", "")
        last_updated = ti_record.get("ti-last-updated", ti_record.get("last-updated", ""))
        
        parsed_time = parse_timestamp(last_updated)
        formatted_time = format_datetime(parsed_time, include_timezone=False) if parsed_time else "N/A"
        
        type_display = observable_type.upper() if observable_type else "Unknown"
        if observable_type == "md5":
            type_display = "MD5 Hash"
        elif observable_type == "sha256":
            type_display = "SHA256 Hash"
        elif observable_type == "sha1":
            type_display = "SHA1 Hash"
        elif observable_type == "domain":
            type_display = "Domain"
        elif observable_type == "ipv4":
            type_display = "IPv4 Address"
        elif observable_type == "ipv6":
            type_display = "IPv6 Address"
        elif observable_type == "url":
            type_display = "URL"
        
        verdict_lower = verdict.lower() if verdict else ""
        verdict_class = "verdict-unknown"
        if verdict_lower == "malicious":
            verdict_class = "verdict-malicious"
        elif verdict_lower == "suspicious":
            verdict_class = "verdict-suspicious"
        elif verdict_lower == "benign":
            verdict_class = "verdict-benign"
        
        html_parts.append(f'''
        <div class="reference-item">
            <h4>Observable: {escape(report_term(str(observable)))} ({escape(report_term(type_display))})</h4>
            <div class="reference-details">
                <p><strong>Verdict:</strong> <span class="{verdict_class}">{escape(report_term(str(verdict)))}</span></p>
                <p><strong>Risk Score:</strong> {escape(report_term(str(risk_score)))}</p>
                <p><strong>Date of Last Update:</strong> {formatted_time}</p>
                {f'<p><strong>Tracking ID:</strong> {escape(report_term(str(tracking_id)))}</p>' if tracking_id else ''}
            </div>
        </div>
        ''')
    
    return '\n'.join(html_parts)


def render_mitre_techniques(case: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Render MITRE ATT&CK techniques from the case."""
    mitre = case.get("mitre-attack-techniques", [])
    
    if not mitre:
        return ""
    
    if not isinstance(mitre, list):
        mitre = [mitre]
    
    techniques = set(str(t) for t in mitre if t)
    
    if not techniques:
        return ""
    
    html_parts = ['<div class="mitre-techniques">', '<h4>MITRE ATT&CK Techniques:</h4>', '<ul>']
    for technique in sorted(techniques):
        html_parts.append(f'<li>{escape(report_term(technique))}</li>')
    html_parts.extend(['</ul>', '</div>'])
    
    return '\n'.join(html_parts)
